summary: Devin's $0 plan gives you a light quota of the autonomous coding agent plus unlimited Tab completions in the IDE extension. It is aimed at trying out agent-driven tasks before upgrading to a paid plan.
claim_steps: Open devin.ai/pricing and pick the Free $0 plan.
Sign up with your email or a Google/GitHub account.
Start a Devin session from the dashboard within your free quota.
Install the IDE extension for unlimited Tab completions.

social_proof.title: Devin pricing — Free $0 plan
social_proof.text: Free $0 — Light quota to code with agents. Unlimited Tab completions.
